## AccrualPosition.healthFactor property

This position's health factor (collateral power over debt, scaled by WAD). If the debt is 0, health factor is `MaxUint256`<!-- -->. `undefined` if the market's oracle is undefined or reverts.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get healthFactor(): bigint | undefined;
```
